IC1: Patient has provided signed informed consent
IC2: Patient is aged greater than or equal to 40 and less than or equal to 89 years of age
IC3: Patient has a prostate size [AND] between 90g and 200g, as determined by MRI
IC4: Patient has experienced lower urinary tract symptoms (LUTS) for at least 6 months prior to study enrollment
IC5: Patient has an IPSS score of at least 13 at baseline
IC6: Patient is either: refractory to medical treatment [OR], contraindicated to medical treatment [OR], OR refuses medical treatment
IC7: Patient either: refuses surgical treatment [OR] OR is contraindicated for surgical treatment
IC8: Patient meets ONE of the following criteria: baseline PSA < 4.0ng/mL [OR] (no prostate biopsy required) OR baseline PSA >/= 4 ng/mL AND a negative prostate biopsy (minimum 12 core biopsy) within the prior 12 months
